post.title: Bank error in your favor? Why it's usually not yours to keep
post.ig:
A bank error in your favor usually isn't yours to keep.
US regulator OCC: a bank doesn't need your permission to remove a deposit made in error. Nacha rules allow a mistaken ACH payment to be reversed within 5 banking days.
April 2024: Citi credited a client $81 trillion instead of $280, reversed within hours (FT, Feb 2025).
Aug 2020: Citi wired about $900M to Revlon's lenders by mistake; a 2021 ruling let some keep about $500M, reversed on appeal in Sept 2022.
May 2021: Crypto.com sent about A$10.5M by mistake in Australia; the recipient's partner was later jailed for 3 years for theft.
Sources: OCC HelpWithMyBank, Nacha Operating Rules, Financial Times, US Court of Appeals (2nd Cir.), AAP.
